rule: D013, D040, D092 (A); GLOSSARY 8.2; old F-604
summary: LiveEnablementController.enable admits kill-gate state WITHIN_BUDGET ('keep researching'); only INSUFFICIENT_EDGE or an unevaluated state is refused, and a test pins WITHIN_BUDGET as allowed. The planned LIVE path therefore needs no evidence of edge.
expected: LIVE/CANARY enable requires PASSING_CANDIDATE with a decision reference, or a recorded owner waiver naming the family and a loss cap.
actual: enable() refuses only non-KillGateState and INSUFFICIENT_EDGE (enablement.py:263-272); tests/test_execution_enablement.py:350-364 asserts enable succeeds at WITHIN_BUDGET. With G-0903 (kill gate stays WITHIN_BUDGET when nothing is recorded) the only barrier is that no LIVE enable path exists yet.
impact: Once Phase 26 builds the LIVE path on this controller, real money can trade a strategy whose research shows a negative mean (a01 -0.10 R pooled Validation) with every machine check green.
evidence: enablement.py:263-272; docstring 'PASSING_CANDIDATE only records that evidence exists and NEVER authorizes live trading by itself'; enums.py:188-189 'WITHIN_BUDGET ... keep researching'; D092 (A).
why_tests_miss: The test encodes the permissive rule as correct.
recommendation: Owner decision; then require PASSING_CANDIDATE (or a recorded waiver) for LIVE in enable() and invert the test.
known_prior: F-604 (2026-09-29 audit) expected 'enable requires PASSING_CANDIDATE'; related G-0903, G-0901, G-2101

summary: VERIFICATION reports of phases 20-23 were last committed before 7, 13, 1 and 9 later src commits of the same phase (review-fix waves); phase 23 is marked passed for code whose CONFIRM timing rule changed afterwards.
expected: A verification cited as evidence is re-run or amended after the phase's last code change, and names the commit it verified.
actual: git log: 20 b973f155 then 7 fix(20) commits; 21 880fa879 then 13; 22 662f14e6 then 1; 23 f05466a7 (passed) then 9, e.g. 1ea8e274 fix(23): WR-11.
impact: Readers overrate what was verified; low by itself because CI and the per-phase suite still run.
evidence: git log of the snapshot, see lane file row F-807 and G-1701.
reproduction: git log -1 --format=%h -- <VERIFICATION>; git log --oneline <that>..HEAD -- src | grep '(23'
why_tests_miss: No gate ties a VERIFICATION file to a commit.
recommendation: Stamp each VERIFICATION with its verified commit; re-verify or append after review-fix waves.
